title: Can I BEAT Battle Chess?
summary: The creator plays a 3D 'Battle Chess' game (single player, 'create a new battle') where the pieces are animated characters who walk to their squares, idle with personalities (kicking feet, strongman poses, wand twirling) and fight in animated combat on every capture. AI skill levels: Peasant, Farmer, Artisan, Nobleman, Clergyman, Monarch. He plays the Peasant AI as the blue team with the London system, enjoys capture animations (fist bump when castling, bicep attack, mocking gesture, cobbled on the head, gun smoke), deliberately promotes to see the promotion animation, and wins by checkmate; the surviving pieces celebrate. Rules are standard chess.
rules: AI difficulty ladder: Peasant, Farmer, Artisan, Nobleman, Clergyman, Monarch (only Peasant is played in this video per transcript).
Every move is animated: pieces walk to target squares; every capture triggers a unique attacker-vs-defender combat animation; castling, promotion and checkmate have special animations.
